test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B are participants in a 1,800 m circular race. A is running at a speed of 24 km/h and B is running at a speed of 15 km/h. If both start from the same point and at the same time and run in the same direction, find the time when they will meet again. (up to two decimal points)
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of A = 24 km/h

Speed of B = 15 km/h

Distance of the race = 1800 m

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed = Speed of A - Speed of B

Time to meet again = Distance / Relative Speed
